requirements.quote: `forgedock selftest --journey` (or similar) runs both stages and fails on the regressions above.
Its result is posted on the release PR next to GATE_PASS.
A fresh container with only Node and git: `npx forgedock` from the packed tarball. Assert the not-ready output, the files written, and the doctor output.

With gh authenticated to the sandbox account and Claude Code available (`sandbox_repo` from the selftest config): setup on a fresh sandbox repo, `doctor` green, `demo --run` or first issue to merged PR.
Record time to first merged PR (#5290) and every prompt shown.
Snapshot the user-visible output (banner, help, doctor, errors) so wording regressions show up in review.
A scripted new-user journey test, run before each release on the host (not Actions minutes, see #5277/#5278):

deliverables.change: New module: runJourney({io,...}) with stage 1 (pack, clean env npx, assert not-ready output, files written, doctor output), stage 2 (sandbox setup, doctor green, demo --run to merged PR, time-to-first-merge and prompts recorded, cleanup always), scrubbed snapshot compare with --update-snapshots; all process access via injected io; stage 2 skipped with a note when gh/claude unavailable
Unit tests with fake io: stage-1 regressions (false success banner, missing file, doctor wording drift) fail; stage 2 records ttfm and prompts; cleanup runs on failure; snapshot diff and update

selftestFromCli: accept --journey (+ --update-snapshots), reuse sandbox repo resolution and project/release-repo refusal, print result, exit non-zero naming the step, post journey marker when --pr given; update usage strings
Add buildJourneyMarker/parseJourneyMarker/postJourneyMarker for `<!-- FORGE:JOURNEY result= sha= step= ttfm= -->`, separate from FORGE:SELFTEST so neither overwrites the other
Tests for the journey marker build/parse and that it does not affect selftestGate
Committed scrubbed snapshots of user-visible output (add sibling help.txt, doctor.txt, not-ready.txt, errors.txt in the same dir)
Document --journey stages, snapshots, marker next to GATE_PASS, host-only (never Actions)

preserve.what: `selftest --static` and `--live` behaviour, steps and exit codes in bin/lean/selftest-live.mjs and its tests
FORGE:SELFTEST marker format and selftestGate fail-closed semantics in bin/lean/selftest-gate.mjs, as consumed by bin/review-staging.mjs:242-249

validate.command: node --test bin/lean/selftest-journey.test.mjs bin/lean/selftest-gate.test.mjs bin/lean/selftest-live.test.mjs bin/lean/selftest-nightly.test.mjs bin/lean/selftest-static.test.mjs

decisions.choice: Separate FORGE:JOURNEY marker instead of reusing FORGE:SELFTEST
decisions.justification: selftestGate takes the newest FORGE:SELFTEST marker (bin/lean/selftest-gate.mjs:28), so a journey result would overwrite the live result; the issue asks only for posting next to GATE_PASS, not gating

decisions.choice: All process access (docker/npm pack/npx/gh) injected via io, real binding only in realIo; no mocked-vs-real swap for the stage logic beyond unit fakes, live run is a host command
